links.function: hearing and processing the ticking sound from the ears
links.narration_bridge: First, each tick races from the ears into the auditory cortex, the brain's hearing center, lighting up right before the meal arrives.

links.function: driving automatic reflexes like salivation via the salivary nuclei
links.narration_bridge: Next, when food follows that sound again and again, the hearing center links directly to the brainstem, the automatic reflex center that drives drooling.
